title: Muleshoe National Wildlife Refuge
summary: Muleshoe National Wildlife Refuge is the oldest national wildlife refuge in Texas and was established in 1935. Located in the High Plains of west Texas, the refuge is important to migratory birds and many resident species of wildlife, the refuge is best known for hosting one of the largest concentrations of lesser sandhill cranes in North America.
